claim: Blood says how a switch is worked by its height and its art together: pressed switches hang a median 0.79 standing heights above their floor (453 of them, quartiles 0.60-0.79), at or just under the eye (0.83), because use is a hitscan from the eye; shot switches hang a median 1.93 (63, quartiles 1.00-3.26) and wear different tiles (2290, 710, 1165 against 1070, 1046, 1078). Of 50 exit switches 41 wear tile 318, which appears only 5 times elsewhere.
evidence: knowledge/blood/design/switches-v1.json, every sprite of types 20-23 in the 43 campaign maps (bloodmap/switches.py)
use: Hang a pressed switch at about 0.8 bodies with a lever or button tile, a shot switch high with a target tile, and put tile 318 on the exit.
